name: Mark Twain
q: When with the majority, pause and reflect
Thank fools; without them we couldn't succeed
Easier to stay out than get out
Nothing's more annoying than a good example
Training is everything; the peach was once bitter
Happier to be born eighty, growing to eighteen
Health means doing what you'd rather not
Dress carelessly, but keep a tidy soul
Do right; it will astonish the rest
Loyalty to old opinions frees no soul
Courage is mastery of fear, not its absence
Wrinkles mark where smiles have been
Live so the undertaker will be sorry
April 1: what we are the other 364
Man is the only animal that blushes. Or needs to
Tell the truth — then you don't have to remember anything
